title: Increase Muon matrix learning rate
reflection: val_bpb 0.997323 vs baseline 0.996553: regression of +0.000770. All three agents independently converged on this untested idea, but increasing the Muon matrix LR made things worse. The baseline embedding:matrix LR ratio of 15:1 is better-tuned than 12:1. This confirms the tight local optimum is real across parameter-group-specific LRs as well. Single-parameter changes continue to fail; the baseline remains robust. Future rounds should explore multi-parameter coordination or fundamentally different architectures (activations, attention patterns, layer design).
